jobs.description:
Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position and the main working language.

 
• 
Good knowledge of French.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 

airline and MICE guests. 

Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 

it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll do
You'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 

• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 

• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 

• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 

• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 

• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 

• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 

• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are
• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 

• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 

• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 

• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 

• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 

• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

I-The role
Based in our Brussels office, you will work in close, direct collaboration with the Global Director of Brand & Digital Marketing and the wider international Marketing team, to ensure the consistency, quality and visibility of digital content across our hotels' distribution and booking platforms. As the central point of contact for content moderation group-wide, you will safeguard the brand's online image, editorial and legal compliance, and user experience across all of the collection's websites. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work at the heart of international hotel digital marketing, online distribution platforms, and content optimization for search engines and AI-powered tools.

II-Key responsibilities

A.Collection knowledge
-Develop an in-depth understanding of the hotels in the collection, their positioning and unique features.
-Become fully familiar with the group's brand standards and digital ecosystem.

B.Digital content audits
-Conduct detailed audits of content across the official website, booking engine, OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, etc.), Google Business Profile, B2B/MICE platforms (Cvent) and other partner platforms.

C.Content harmonization and updates
-Ensure consistency of information across platforms: hotel descriptions, room categories and names, amenities and services, visual content and photo libraries, editorial tone and brand image.
-Continuously update and optimize content.

D.Search engine and AI model (LLM) optimization
-Optimize content structure and markup (structured data, schema.org, llms.txt files, FAQ content, etc.) to maximize visibility and accuracy across search engines and generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot, etc.).
-Regularly audit how the collection's hotels are represented in AI-generated answers, identify gaps or inaccurate information, and coordinate corrections.
-Support the improvement of quality and standardization of hotel data to help AI systems interpret it correctly.

E.Monitoring and continuous improvement in generative AI
-Actively track the fast-moving evolution of large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered search tools, along with emerging best practices (GEO ¿ Generative Engine Optimization, AEO ¿ Answer Engine Optimization).
-Translate this ongoing monitoring into concrete recommendations and continuously adjust content strategy as algorithms and tools evolve.
-Share learnings and best practices with the Marketing team and other stakeholders across the group. F.Liaison with the collection's hotels
-Act as the main point of contact for hotel properties' local teams for the collection, validation and regular updating of their content (information, photos, offers, events).
-Maintain regular follow-up with each property to ensure responsiveness, reliability and freshness of content across all platforms.

G.Content moderation and quality control
-Moderate, review and approve all content published on the collection's hotel websites prior to going live.
-Ensure compliance with editorial guidelines, brand standards, legal requirements and accessibility norms across all platforms.
 

H.Technical and cross-functional coordination
-Work with IT/web development teams, hotel properties and external agencies to resolve technical issues (broken links, outdated pages, faulty forms).
-Coordinate translation and localization of content across the collection's markets and languages.
-Manage a publishing calendar and prioritize update requests coming from individual properties.

I.Monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement
-Provide regular reporting on content quality, compliance and performance (KPIs, dashboards).
-Stay current on best practices in content moderation, SEO and user experience.
 
-Degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management or a related field.
-First experience in web content management or moderation, ideally within the hospitality, travel, or a multi-site environment.
-Experience with one or more CMS platforms (WordPress or equivalent) and web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).
-Excellent attention to detail, rigor, and a strong sense of editorial and legal compliance.
-Genuine interest in the hospitality industry and digital environments.
-Strong analytical and coordination skills, comfortable managing multiple priorities across a multi-market environment.
-Proficiency with digital platforms and content management tools.
-Genuine curiosity about generative AI technologies (LLMs) and their impact on digital discoverability; willingness to continuously learn in this fast-evolving field.
-Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, comfortable liaising with multiple stakeholders (hotels, internal teams, external partners).
-Excellent written and spoken French and English; any additional language is an asset.
 
Type: Sales and Marketing

Localisation: Bruxelles

Type de contrat: CDI

Contrat: Temps plein

Expérience: Moins d'1 an

Langue(s): Français, Anglais

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
